title: The US FCC exempts some new models of foreign-made drones and critical components from an import ban, announced in December 2025, until the end of 2026 (David Shepardson/Reuters)
summary: David Shepardson / Reuters: The US FCC exempts some new models of foreign-made drones and critical components from an import ban, announced in December 2025, until the end of 2026 — The U.S. Federal Communications Commission said on Wednesday it is exempting imports of some new models of foreign-made drones …
